# ModifyTreeViewNode <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzPlus](BlitzPlus) · [Tree Views](BlitzPlus-Tree-Views)

</div>


```blitzbasic
ModifyTreeViewNode:Void node:Int32, text:String, icon:Int32=-1
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `node` | In | Int32 | required | Handle of a node. |
| `text` | In | String | required | The new text. |
| `icon` | In | Int32 | `-1` | Number of an icon of the tree. Defaults to -1, which means none. |

## Description

Changes the text of a node.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 32, 2
win  = CreateWindow("Modify", 10, 10, 300, 200, Desktop(), 3)
tree = CreateTreeView(10, 10, 270, 140, win)
n = AddTreeViewNode("Old", TreeViewRoot(tree))
ModifyTreeViewNode n, "New"
Repeat
Until WaitEvent() = $803
```
